features.text: Advanced elastic tension system provides consistent therapeutic compression throughout your daily activities, promoting healing while maintaining comfort
Universal design fits both left and right feet, featuring an easy-to-use application system that works with all types of footwear
Slim profile allows wear under socks while maintaining effective pressure for plantar fasciitis and heel pain relief
Durable construction ensures long-lasting support and consistent compression for ongoing therapeutic benefits
